name: methods
value: Survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Groups were compared using the log-rank test. Restricted mean survival time was computed up to 2 years with 95% confidence intervals based on the Greenwood variance formula. The between-group RMST difference is reported as .1000000014901161 minus .2000000029802322 (the first minus the second by() group in ascending order of group), with a 95% confidence interval and two-sided Wald p-value based on the independent-group variance. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
